description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging (Unless Bulk Packed)
Genuine Suzuki OEM Part
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
These are the Hardtop to Body Attachment Hardware Kit
Includes the Front LH & RH Pieces and the Side LH & RH Pieces
Includes a set of Attachment Screws
There are many different Hardtops made so verify the correct hardware before buying. This kit does not fit all makes of Hardtops
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Right Hand Bracket
Qty 1 – Front Left Hand Bracket
Qty 1 – Side Right Hand Bracket
Qty 1 – Side Left Hand Bracket
Qty 16 – Attachment Screws
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
SJ413 Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
SJ410 Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
Maruti Gypsy Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
Santana Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
Holden Drover Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
Suzuki Sierra Fitment Varies Based on Hardtop Type
